scenarios.name: Cancel staged commands on two ribbon targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are empty
ribbon customization is open with All Commands as the source
the user adds "2D Sketches" to Part Tools
the user selects Part Manage as the target
the user adds "3D Annotations" to Part Manage
Part Manage is marked as having pending changes
the user clicks Cancel without applying the changes
the user reopens ribbon customization from Tools
Part Tools is selected and its target list is empty
"2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are available in the source list
the user selects Part Manage as the target
the target selector has no pending-change marker
